name: Asenapine
effects: Sublingual only — extensive first-pass eliminates oral bioavailability
Broad receptor profile: D2/D3, 5HT2A/2B/2C/6/7, H1, alpha1/2 antagonism
Local oral hypoesthesia (numbness) — do not eat or drink for 10 minutes post-dose
Weight gain moderate; metabolic profile intermediate

halfLifeEvidence.quote: Following an initial more rapid distribution phase, the terminal half life of asenapine is approximately 24 hours. … Following an initial more rapid distribution phase, the mean terminal half-life is approximately 24 hrs.
